message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **federal public holidays** that create “long weekends” (i.e., a holiday falls on a weekday adjacent to a weekend) in Canada for the year 2023.  
(Provincial holidays such as *Civic Holiday* in most provinces, *Family Day* in Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc., are already listed where they apply.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Why it’s a long weekend |
|-------------|---------|-------------|--------------------------|
| **January 2** | New Year’s Day (observed) | Monday | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday 1 → holiday moved to Monday 2 |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Monday | Fixed Monday holiday |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday | Friday holiday |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | Fixed Monday holiday |
| **August 7** | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Monday | Fixed Monday holiday |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | Saturday holiday |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Fixed Monday holiday |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Fixed Monday holiday |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | Fixed Monday holiday |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | Tuesday holiday (adjacent to Monday) |

### Quick notes

- **Remembrance Day (November 11)** falls on a Wednesday in 2023, so it does **not** create a long weekend.  
- Some provinces observe additional holidays that can add extra long weekends (e.g., *St. Patrick’s Day* in Ontario, *National Indigenous Peoples Day* in British Columbia, *Heritage Day* in Quebec, etc.).  
- If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can tailor the list accordingly.  

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your holiday‑planning app!
